This page contains items which either cannot be seen or equipped by the player or which exist only in the [[Skyrim Mod:Creation Kit|Creation Kit]] and cannot be obtained without the use of the [[Skyrim:Console|console]]. For information on unused content in general, please see the [[Skyrim:Unused Content|related page]].

==BSA-only Items==
Models, textures, and icons for these items are present in a [[Skyrim Mod:Archive File Format|BSA (Bethesda Softworks Archive)]], but the items themselves haven't been created in the game files. Names are assigned based on the filenames.

{|class=wikitable
!
!Name
!Notes
|-
|[[File:SR-item-Ring of Khajiit.jpg|75px]]
|[[SR:Ring of Khajiit|{{Anchor|Ring of Khajiit}}]]
|
*The asset files misspell the name as "Khajit"; the item has been spelled "Ring of Khajiit" or "Ring of Khajiiti" in the past.
*A Daedric Artifact associated with two Daedric Princes, [[Skyrim:Meridia|Meridia]] and [[Skyrim:Mephala|Mephala]]. For historical information, please see the [[Lore:Ring of Khajiiti|lore page]].
*This ring is [[SR:Ring of Khajiit|added to the game]] by the [[SR:Fishing|Fishing]] [[SR:Creation Club|Creation]].
|}
